reels.title: Qualcomm and Arm Holdings share slide as the two see weakness in smartphone market
reels.summary:
Qualcomm stock slid on Thursday, leading chip stocks lower after the company issued a light forecast.

Semiconductor peers, including Arm Holdings, also declined Thursday, continuing a post-election selloff on fears of a data center slowdown, as Democrats indicated plans for artificial intelligence regulation.
